cases.prompt: Vet a third-party gh skill install candidate for license, provenance, scripts, permissions, and secret access before I approve installation.
Review the complete old and new trees of an external agent skill update, including dotfiles and symlinks, and pin the acceptable revision.
An unfamiliar skill repository includes opaque binaries, hidden Unicode, and a downloader. Decide whether we may stage it without executing anything.
Author a first-party skill for our catalog with portable frontmatter, a concise workflow, and routing examples; there is no external installation candidate.
Review this application pull request for behavioral regressions, error handling, and test gaps rather than vetting a downloaded skill.
